package app
import "testing"
func TestConcatenated(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skip("not " + "yet")
}
func TestParenthesized(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skip(("not " + "yet"))
}
func TestFormatted(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skipf("not " + "yet: %s", "reason")
}
func TestLane(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		t.Skip("short " + "mode: unavailable")
	}
}
